![](asset:P000325-stem-1)Three blocks of mass 1 kg, 4 kg and 2 kg are placed on a smooth horizontal plane as shown in figure. Find:
(i) the acceleration of the system.
(ii) the normal force between 1 kg block and 4 kg block.
(iii) the net force on 2 kg block.

assets.alt: Three blocks in contact on a horizontal surface: 1 kg, 4 kg and 2 kg. A 120 N force pushes the 1 kg block to the right, and a 50 N force pushes the 2 kg block to the left.
